assumptions: SALESDOCUMENT equality is the only permitted order-reference match.
Invoice labels in overdue reports refer to embedded SALESDOCUMENT rows unless an explicit invoice_number is present.
Amounts are comparable only when both sources expose the same business measure and currency.
Document created_date/report_date/report_week/period are reported separately from referenced transaction creation dates.
objective: Extract document KPIs and reconcile every embedded order/invoice reference to the selected exact-key operational sources, reporting arithmetic, identifier, customer, currency, and period disagreements.
strategy: First run toolkit profile_data with exact parameters on the document sources; then use one deterministic owner-authored parser/reconciliation script because nested document extraction and cross-source exact-key comparison are not supported by the toolkit. Validate all 32 business documents, exact SALESDOCUMENT joins, counts, sums, dates, customer IDs, currencies, duplicate snapshots, and unsupported amount comparisons.
